name: GOV.UK Frontend (translated)
description: GOV.UK Frontend's form language on the t-* vocabulary: 2px square borders, no radius, the fat 3px focus block in a warning-derived accent, bold labels above fields, 5px error bar on invalid fields, big solid buttons with the bottom shadow line, inset-text alerts, uppercase tinted tags, summary-list settings rows and GOV.UK tables. Light-first by birth, token-driven so dark palettes read.
notes: Translated, not vendored: GOV.UK Frontend styles per-class (govuk-*) with hard-coded hex for buttons, tags, inputs and the header, and sets no body font; aliasing it onto tailor markup would need the markup to change (SKIN-CONTRACT rule 5). Declarations are re-expressed on t-* selectors. Licence: GDS Transport font and the crown/GOV.UK wordmark are gov.uk-only, so the skin uses the system sans stack and draws no crown or logo anywhere. Focus: GOV.UK's #ffdd00 is a colour literal and therefore banned; the focus block is color-mix(--t-warning 70%, --t-hue-yellow) with --t-overlay-bg/--t-canvas-derived text, visible on both modes. GOV.UK has no dark mode, no toasts, menus, tooltips, cards, switches or sidebar; those are composed in its idiom (notification-banner toasts, bordered summary cards, square checkbox-style switch, 5px-bordered dialog like the timeout pattern).
